parameters.formDescription: Step 1 of 4. One Google Sheet holds your campaigns, laid out as blocks. Say where it is. Next you choose the campaign, the project and the templates, and the campaign is queued for the Figma plugin.

values.placeholder: e.g. en, de, fr (leave empty for all languages)

parameters.formDescription: Step 2 of 4. The campaigns found in the sheet, with their dates.
parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ fieldLabel: 'Campaign', fieldType: 'dropdown', requiredField: true, fieldOptions: { values: $json.campaigns.map((c) => ({ option: c.label })) } }]) }}

parameters.formDescription: Step 3 of 4. The projects linked in Creatives. The default project is listed first.
parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ fieldLabel: 'Project', fieldType: 'dropdown', requiredField: true, fieldOptions: { values: [...$json.projects].sort((a, b) => Number(b.default) - Number(a.default)).map((p) => ({ option: p.name })) } }]) }}

parameters.formDescription: Step 4 of 4. Every template and aspect ratio in the project (template/ratio). Pick as many as you need.
parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ fieldLabel: 'Creatives', fieldType: 'dropdown', multiselect: true, requiredField: true, fieldOptions: { values: Object.entries($json.templates).flatMap(([template, ratios]) => Object.keys(ratios).map((ratio) => ({ option: template + '/' + ratio }))) } }]) }}

parameters.completionMessage: ={{ 'Queued "' + $json.name + '": ' + $json.frames + ' frames in ' + $json.languages.join(', ') + '. Open the Creatives plugin in Figma and click Generate.' }}
